question: Where was India’s first hockey club founded?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcutta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Calcutta** was the location where India's first hockey club was founded.
 
• The club was established in **1885-86**, making it a significant event in the history of Indian hockey.
 
• Calcutta, now known as Kolkata, has a rich history of sports and was a major center for various sporting activities during the British colonial period.
 
• The establishment of the hockey club in Calcutta marked the beginning of organized hockey in India.
 
• This event played a crucial role in popularizing the sport across the country and laid the foundation for India's future successes in international hockey.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey** is a popular sport in India, with a rich history and numerous achievements on the international stage.
 
• India has won **multiple Olympic gold medals** in hockey, with the first gold coming in **1928**.
 
• The Indian hockey team is known for its skillful play and has produced many legendary players over the years.
 
• Efforts have been made to revive the sport in the country through various leagues and grassroots programs.
 
• Hockey continues to be a source of pride and inspiration for many Indians.
